title: fix(setup-copy): approval, security, automation and sharing descriptions read as admin copy; ADR numbers move to comments
body:
Fixes #23829
Clause-②: no

## What changed

The sentence an administrator reads under a Setup page title is the object's `description`; a field's help tooltip is the field's `description`; the Permission Sets page lists each shipped set with its `description`. This PR rewrites those strings in the four `domain:services` packages the card names (`plugin-approvals`, `plugin-security`, `service-automation`, `plugin-sharing`) and moves every ADR number, decision id and review-finding id out of the strings into a comment beside each one or the docblock that already cites it. Docblocks and ADR links in code stay. Wording only: no field, index, permission or behaviour change.

Form copied from #23845 (the parent #23802's landed PR): field help keeps its operational text and loses only the design-record reference; object descriptions are rewritten as one sentence.

## Before / after

Measured by loading every object each package exports from `src` (13 objects, every string leaf at any depth, multi-line values included) plus `plugin-security`'s 8 shipped permission sets, against the card's patterns (`ADR-` followed by a digit, a decision id such as D2, `finding F`, `emit()`, `kernel`). Before, at base `94114c1f26`: 26 object strings and 3 permission-set descriptions matched. After: 0 and 0. The card's own reading (single-line values only) had found 9 of the 29.

Object descriptions, rewritten:

| Object (where Setup shows it) | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `sys_approval_delegation` (Approvals, Delegations (OOO)) | Self-service out-of-office rule: route this user's approver slots to a delegate within a time window. | While someone is away, approvals assigned to them personally go to their delegate. |
| `sys_record_share` (Access Control, Record Shares) | Per-record sharing grant — extends OWD with explicit access | Records shared beyond their owner, one row per grant. |
| `sys_user_position` (a user's Positions list, View all) | Assigns a position, by name, to a user. Platform-owned (ADR-0057 D4, ADR-0090 D3). | Which positions each user holds, one row per assignment. |
| `sys_audience_binding_suggestion` (no Setup page) | Package-suggested everyone-anchor grant and the deployment-level decision on it (ADR-0090 D5/D9). | A package's suggestion to give one of its permission sets to everyone who signs in, and the decision taken on it. |
| `sys_automation_run` (no Setup page) | Durable automation run state: live suspended runs (resumable, ADR-0019) and terminal run history (completed / failed / cancelled / timed_out / refused, for observability). | Paused automation runs waiting to resume, and the recent history of finished runs. |

The Approval Delegations sentence departs from the card's starting sentence ("Route your approvals to someone else while you are away.") on purpose: `ApprovalService.expandApprovers` reroutes only individually-routed approvers (`user` / `field` / `manager`); team, department, position and membership-level approvers are not rerouted, so "your approvals" would promise more than the runtime does. The comment beside the string says so.

Field help and other strings, the design-record reference removed and the rest unchanged:

- `sys_approval_request`: `flow_run_id`, `flow_node_id`, `node_config_json` ("(ADR-0019)"; the section comment already cites it).
- `sys_approval_delegation.valid_from` ("(ADR-0091 D2 predicate)").
- `sys_audience_binding_suggestion`: `package_id` ("ADR-0086 D3 provenance"), `anchor` ("ADR-0090 D9").
- `sys_user_position`: `business_unit_id`, `valid_from`, `valid_until`, `reason`, `delegated_from`, `last_certified_at`, `certified_by` (the "[ADR-0091 Dn]" / "[ADR-0090 Addendum]" prefixes and the "(D2)", "(D3)", "(D4)", "(D12)" ids), and the `reserved_identity_position` validation's description ("ADR-0068 D2").
- Permission set `organization_admin_no_bypass`: "(ADR-0105 D4 / finding F2)". Its producer is `deriveWallLessOrgAdmin` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts`; the card's reading missed it because the description is a multi-line concatenation.

## Beyond the card's list, in the same packages

These sit in the four packages but not in the card's list. Each is the same defect (design-record vocabulary in admin copy), the fix is the same mechanical removal, no open PR touches the file, and each is covered by the same pin and bundle family, so it is fixed here rather than reported. Without them, each package's pin over every object it ships would be red.

- `sys_user_permission_set` (plugin-security; a user's Permission Sets list and its grant form): `permission_set`, `valid_from`, `valid_until`, `reason`, `last_certified_at`, `certified_by` help and the `validity_window_order` validation's description. These are the byte-identical "[ADR-0091 Dn]" phrases of the sibling `sys_user_position`, in the same bundle.
- Permission sets `mcp_agent_data_read` and `mcp_agent_data_write` (same producer file as `organization_admin_no_bypass`): "via the ADR-0090 D10 intersection" became "by the delegating user's own permissions".
- `reservedIdentityNameMessage` (plugin-security `objects/reserved-identity-names.ts`): the refusal a Setup assignment form shows read "These names are ADR-0068 built-in identities"; it now reads "These names are built-in identities". It is a leaf of every locale's security bundle. The tests compare against the function, so none changed.
- `sys_flow_dispatch` (service-automation; no Setup page): "a rebuilt kernel" became "a reload or restart".

## Setup reachability

- Setup nav entries: `sys_approval_request`, `sys_approval_action`, `sys_approval_delegation` (`approvals-plugin.ts`), `sys_record_share`, `sys_sharing_rule` (`sharing-plugin.ts`).
- Reached through the user record page: `sys_user_position` and `sys_user_permission_set` (the Positions and Permission Sets related lists in `platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`; New opens each object's form, View all opens its list page).
- Permission sets: Access Control, Permission Sets (`/apps/setup/metadata/permission`).
- **Not reachable from Setup** (no nav entry, no record page in this repository): `sys_audience_binding_suggestion` (objectui reads its rows through a dedicated suggested-bindings API and renders its own copy) and `sys_automation_run`. Both are cleaned because the card names them.

## Translations

`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write --filter=approvals|security|sharing` regenerated the `en` bundles from source. `service-automation` generates no bundle. Merge mode keeps every non-empty translated-locale value, so the order was the one #23845 used:

1. Translated leaves whose source moved were edited in place, leaf values only: plugin-security zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES (13 help texts with the same references removed, and the `sys_user_position` description re-translated); plugin-sharing zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES (the `sys_record_share` description); plugin-approvals zh-CN (the delegation description and `valid_from` help).
2. English fills with recorded provenance were emptied and refilled by the generator, which refreshed their source hashes: the three `flow_*` help texts in all three approvals locales, the delegation description and `valid_from` help in approvals ja-JP and es-ES, and the reserved-position refusal in all three security locales.
3. The bundle commit (the hand edits above plus the regeneration) touches only these leaves and their hash entries: 18 files, 100 insertions and 100 deletions.

## Pins (acceptance 2)

One unit test per package, in the form #23845 landed (`service-messaging/src/objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`). That pin restates its matcher rather than importing a shared helper, so these do the same. No new `check:*` script, lint rule or CI wiring.

- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`: every object the package exports plus `sys_approval_token` (registered by the plugin, not exported); every leaf of the four `objects` bundles.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`: every object `objects/index.ts` exports; the label and description of every shipped permission set; every leaf of the four bundles.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`: every object `objects/index.ts` exports; every leaf of the four bundles.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`: every object the package exports (no bundle exists).

Each has a positive control showing the matcher recognises every kind of vocabulary, and a minimum roster so the population cannot quietly shrink.

Ablation, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode, trap-armed restore): " (ADR-0057 D4)" put back into the `sys_user_position` description (anchor 1 to 0, marker 0 to 1, blob `fbd17436adff` to `7ea8a4913087`). The security pin went red on exactly one test, naming `sys_user_position.description (an ADR number, a decision id)`; 6 others stayed green. Restore: blob equal to HEAD (`fbd17436adff`), `git diff HEAD` empty. No build was involved, because the pin imports the object through relative `src` paths, not through a `dist` export.

## Local verification (HEAD `85fb81cfd1`)

Built first: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/cli...` (62 packages, the CLI closure the i18n generator needs, which contains all four packages), exit 0, after merging `origin/main` at `497518c3f6`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test`: 79 files, 1088 tests passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: 187 files, 3721 passed, 45 skipped. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: 47 files, 1073 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-automation test`: 187 files, 2503 passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- Each new pin is in its package's test tsc program (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly`: 1 hit each), which `check:test-typecheck` compiles.
- Derived gate list (`dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 65 families): 64 exit 0, among them `check:i18n` ("10 package(s) — all bundles in sync"), `check:i18n-stale-fill` ("no new stale fills, 0 baselined"), `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:nul-bytes`. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` printed PREREQUISITE NOT MET (exit 3): it reads every package's `dist`, and this worktree built only the CLI closure. That one is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 65 derived, 64 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Also run, not derived: `pnpm check:i18n-coverage`, exit 0 ("621 baselined untranslated string(s), none new").
- Not run locally: `test:repo` and the rest of the farm, which belong to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The declaration-closure reading the dispatch asked for, measured: these packages' built `dist/index.d.ts` carry each object's `description` as a string literal type (`readonly description: "Records shared beyond their owner, one row per grant."`), so the declaration files change byte-wise in those literals only. No export, type shape or accept set moved.
- Out of these packages' object files and left alone: the `everyone` and `guest` built-in positions' descriptions in `plugin-security/src/builtin-positions.ts` carry "(ADR-0090 D5)" and "(ADR-0090 D9)" on Setup's Positions page. That file is outside this card's surface, and `builtin-positions.boot.test.ts` pins the same text as the stored legacy rows the retired seeder wrote, so a change there also moves a stored-row fixture and needs its own reading. Reported to the PM for the family's closing card; the security pin does not judge the positions population.
- `sys_approval_request`'s other descriptions and the excluded `sys-approval-request.page.ts` were not touched (PR #23837 holds the page).
- The Approval Delegations, Record Shares and User Positions sentences are this PR's choices from the card's starting sentences; the reasons are above and in the comments beside the strings.
